name: Easy Redirect – Advanced Redirection
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Easy Redirect – Advanced Redirection is a fast, lightweight, and very simple redirection plugin for WordPress.

Need to retire an old post or direct page traffic to an external link? Easy Redirect – Advanced Redirection allows you to set up permanent 301 redirects directly from the post or page editor.

Features:
* Add custom redirect URLs to any Post or Page.
* Automatically 301 redirects traffic seamlessly.
* Enable or disable global redirection functionality.
* Built with performance and WordPress security in mind.
* Zero bloat – just simple, effective link fixing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the easyredirect-advanced-redirection folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access ‘Easy Redirect’ under ‘Settings’ to enable the redirect engine.
  4. Edit any post or page to set a custom “Redirect URL”.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Added global enable/disable settings.
